description: Fictional recruiting inbox for the public demo. Every company, person, and address is invented and uses the reserved .example TLD. daysAgo is relative to the moment a demo workspace is created; {{date:+N}} renders today plus N days.

emails.subject: Final round interview for Backend Engineer, New Grad at Kestrel AI
